Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of JNJ.
Our cloud segment grew 15% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 49 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2020.
We generated $13.1 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $28.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 290 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
